Fixes laplacian operator convergence (Adds term to satisfy symmetry property). Updates corresponding unit tests.

(Bickley example refactor + docs + formatter via Claude)
title: Unify the CG/DG bickleyjet examples + enforce symmetry in DG laplacian operator

body:
## Purpose

Small enabling changes for DG/CG switching:

- `CommonGrids`/`CommonSpaces` constructors that build a horizontal spectral-element grid accept `discretization = Grids.DG()`. Simplifies building a DG space (rather than going through the low-level `Domain → Mesh → Topology → Space` path), as shown in Bickley jet example.
- Docstring fixes: `SpectralElementSpace1D/2D` name the keywords they forward; `CentralNumericalFlux` and `RusanovNumericalFlux` state their formulas, the caller contract, and an example; additional example for `scalar_laplacian`; `PointSpace` disambiguates itself from `MultiPointSpace` and `MultiColumnFiniteDifferenceSpace`
title: Thread the CG/DG discretization through CommonGrids and CommonSpaces

body:
This PR cleans up the lib packages by deprecating ClimaCoreMakie and ClimaCorePlots. The CI for these are now tested as part of ClimaCore. ClimaCoreVTK is removed and ClimaCoreSpectra is updated to not have ClimaCore as a dependency.

This PR requires a breaking release of ClimaCore to avoid users loading both ClimaCoreMakie and the Makie extension which causes method overwrites. I haven't tested this, but I believe a similar thing would happen with Plots.

In this PR or in another PR, we can delete the lib packages for ClimaCoreMakie and ClimaCorePlots.

I asked a LLM to do this.
title: Clean up lib packages and add extensions
